parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols bgp group external type ex.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] type external peer-as [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group external type ex.command: set protocols bgp group external type external peer-as 100
set protocols bgp group external type ex.explanation: 配置BGP外部组，指定对等AS号。

set protocols bgp group external local-a.command: set protocols bgp group external local-address 2.2.2.9

set protocols bgp group external peer-gr.command: set protocols bgp group external peer-group external

set protocols ospf area 0 interface ge-0.command: set protocols ospf area 0 interface ge-0/0/0.0

set protocols ospf area 0 interface ge-0.template: set protocols ospf area [parameter1] interface [parameter2] unit [parameter3] inherit-attributes
set protocols ospf area 0 interface ge-0.command: set protocols ospf area 0 interface ge-0/0/0.0 unit 1 inherit-attributes
set protocols ospf area 0 interface ge-0.explanation: 配置OSPF区域接口单元继承属性。

set forwarding-options label allocate pe.explanation: 配置标签分配策略为每个VPN分配标签。

set forwarding_options vlan-forwarding e.explanation: 配置VLAN转发的封装类型和VLAN ID。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching virtual-template-id [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family ethernet-switching virtual-template-id 1
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换虚拟模板ID。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching virtual-path-name [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family ethernet-switching virtual-path-name vpls_ad1
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换虚拟路径名称。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family interface-vlan input vlan [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 1 family interface-vlan input vlan 10

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 family inet addr.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 family inet address 10.10.2.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 family inet addr.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 family mpls ip.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 family mpls ip

set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 family etherne.template: set interfaces [parameter1] family ethernet-switching vlan members [parameter2]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 family etherne.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 family ethernet-switching vlan members default
set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 family etherne.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换VLAN成员。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 unit 1 encapsu.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 unit 1 encapsulation dot1q 10
set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 unit 1 encapsu.explanation: 配置接口单元的封装类型和VLAN ID。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 unit 1 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching port-mode [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 unit 1 family.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 unit 1 family ethernet-switching port-mode access
set interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 unit 1 family.explanation: 配置接口单元的以太网交换端口模式。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 family inet addr.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 family inet address 10.20.3.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 family inet addr.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family mp.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family mpls ip
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family mp.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family mpls ip

set routing-instances instance1 vfi vpls.command: set routing-instances instance1 vfi vpls_ad1 target-network 100:1
set routing-instances instance1 vfi vpls.explanation: 配置路由实例的VFI和目标网络。

set routing-instances instance1 protocol.template: set routing-instances [parameter1] protocols bgp group [parameter2] peer-as [parameter3]
set routing-instances instance1 protocol.command: set routing-instances instance1 protocols bgp group external peer-as 100
set routing-instances instance1 protocol.explanation: 配置路由实例的BGP外部组对等AS号。

set routing-instances instance1 protocol.template: set routing-instances [parameter1] protocols bgp group [parameter2] type internal peer-as [parameter3]
set routing-instances instance1 protocol.command: set routing-instances instance1 protocols bgp group internal type internal peer-as 100
set routing-instances instance1 protocol.explanation: 配置路由实例的BGP内部组类型和对等AS号。
